# sdmTMBexperiments

**sdmTMBexperiments** is a collection of experimental helper functions
for working with fitted [sdmTMB](https://github.com/sdmTMB/sdmTMB)
models: model comparison, mesh-resolution sensitivity, retrospective
analysis, survey-specific index comparison, prediction-grid
construction, and diagnostic plotting. It doubles as a showcase of how
to use these functions and a staging ground for methods that may later
be adopted into `sdmTMB`.

The functions may be freely reused. Figures are made using
[ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/), and can be modified
using ggplot syntax. Maps are drawn on
[ggOceanMaps](https://mikkovihtakari.github.io/ggOceanMaps/) basemaps.
The functions in this package are experimental and likely contain bugs.
If you spot one, please file an issue or commit a PR.

📖 **[Documentation and full
walkthrough](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/)** —
start with [Get
started](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/articles/sdmTMBexperiments.html)
for an end-to-end example, or the [function
reference](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/)
for individual functions.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("DeepWaterIMR/sdmTMBexperiments")
```

## Example

``` r

library(sdmTMBexperiments)
#> Loading required package: ggOceanMaps
#> Loading required package: ggplot2
#> ggOceanMaps: Using ~/Documents/ggOceanMapsLargeData as data download
#> folder. This folder is customly defined and does not require
#> downloading the detailed map data again.
library(sdmTMB)

mesh <- make_mesh(pcod, c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 20)
m1 <- sdmTMB(
  density ~ 0 + as.factor(year),
  data = pcod,
  time = "year",
  mesh = mesh,
  family = tweedie()
)
m2 <- sdmTMB(
  density ~ 0 + as.factor(year) + depth_scaled,
  data = pcod,
  time = "year",
  mesh = mesh,
  family = tweedie()
)
nd <- replicate_df(qcs_grid, "year", unique(pcod$year))

# Compare two models: indices, spatial prediction differences, Mohn's rho
cmp <- compare_models(m1, m2, newdata = nd, object_crs = 32609)
#> ℹ `ln_tau_O` is an internal parameter affecting `sigma_O`
#> ℹ `sigma_O` is the spatial standard deviation
#> ℹ `ln_tau_E` is an internal parameter affecting `sigma_E`
#> ℹ `sigma_E` is the spatiotemporal standard deviation
#> ℹ `ln_kappa` is an internal parameter affecting `range`
#> ℹ `range` is the distance at which data are effectively independent
plot(cmp)
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-1.png)

``` r

plot(cmp, type = "spatial")
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-2.png)

This is only a taste of what’s available — see the [Get started
vignette](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/articles/sdmTMBexperiments.html)
for the full walkthrough: retrospective analysis, mesh-resolution
sensitivity, diagnostic plots, prediction grids, and survey-specific
index comparison with the bundled `sebastes` data.

## Citation

The functions can be freely reused in sdmTMB development. If you use
these functions, please cite the function developer (Mikko Vihtakari,
Institute of Marine Research). If you use the package in publications,
please cite it:

``` r

citation("sdmTMBexperiments")
#> To cite package 'sdmTMBexperiments' in publications use:
#> 
#>   Vihtakari M (2026). _sdmTMBexperiments: Experimental Helper Functions
#>   for 'sdmTMB'_. R package version 0.1.2,
#>   <https://github.com/DeepWaterIMR/sdmTMBexperiments>.
#> 
#> A BibTeX entry for LaTeX users is
#> 
#>   @Manual{,
#>     title = {sdmTMBexperiments: Experimental Helper Functions for 'sdmTMB'},
#>     author = {Mikko Vihtakari},
#>     year = {2026},
#>     note = {R package version 0.1.2},
#>     url = {https://github.com/DeepWaterIMR/sdmTMBexperiments},
#>   }
```

# Package index

## Model selection

- [`sdmTMB_selection()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/sdmTMB_selection.md)
  : Compare a set of sdmTMB model-selection candidates
- [`selection_frame()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/selection_frame.md)
  : Complete-case frame for a set of model-selection candidates
- [`best_candidate()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/best_candidate.md)
  : The best candidate in a selection table
- [`add_aic_weights()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/add_aic_weights.md)
  : Add delta-AIC and Akaike weights to a comparison table
- [`sdmTMB_cv_summary()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/sdmTMB_cv_summary.md)
  : Summarise an sdmTMB cross-validation on a per-observation scale

## Model and mesh comparison

- [`compare_models()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/compare_models.md)
  : Compare sdmTMB models
- [`compare_meshes()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/compare_meshes.md)
  : Compare survey indices across different mesh cutoff values
- [`sdmTMB_mesh_cv()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/sdmTMB_mesh_cv.md)
  : Spatial cross-validation across mesh cutoff values

## Retrospective analysis

- [`sdmTMB_retro()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/sdmTMB_retro.md)
  : Retrospective analysis for an sdmTMB index
- [`mohns_rho()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/mohns_rho.md)
  : Mohn's rho for a set of index series

## Survey comparison and prediction grids

- [`compare_surveys()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/compare_surveys.md)
  : Compare individual survey indices to a compiled sdmTMB index
- [`make_survey_prediction_region()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/make_survey_prediction_region.md)
  : Build a concave-hull prediction region from survey positions
- [`make_prediction_grid()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/make_prediction_grid.md)
  : Build a regular prediction grid over a region

## Plotting

- [`plot_mesh()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot_mesh.md)
  : Plot an sdmTMB mesh on a map
- [`plot_prediction_map()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot_prediction_map.md)
  : Map predicted densities from an sdmTMB model
- [`plot_random_field()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot_random_field.md)
  : Map spatial or spatiotemporal random fields
- [`plot_index()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot_index.md)
  : Plot an sdmTMB survey index
- [`plot_fixed_effects()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot_fixed_effects.md)
  : Coefficient plot of sdmTMB fixed effects
- [`plot_variance_partitioning()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot_variance_partitioning.md)
  : Variance partitioning of an sdmTMB model
- [`plot_prediction_histogram()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot_prediction_histogram.md)
  : Histograms of observed and predicted response
- [`plot_residual_qq()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot_residual_qq.md)
  : Quantile-quantile plot of sdmTMB randomized quantile residuals
- [`bubble_map()`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/bubble_map.md)
  : Bubble map of a response variable
- [`plot(`*`<sdmTMB_mesh_comparison>`*`)`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot.sdmTMB_mesh_comparison.md)
  : Plot mesh comparison results
- [`plot(`*`<sdmTMB_mesh_cv>`*`)`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot.sdmTMB_mesh_cv.md)
  : Plot mesh cross-validation results
- [`plot(`*`<sdmTMB_model_comparison>`*`)`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot.sdmTMB_model_comparison.md)
  : Plot sdmTMB model comparison results
- [`plot(`*`<sdmTMB_prediction_grid>`*`)`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot.sdmTMB_prediction_grid.md)
  : Plot a prediction grid on a map
- [`plot(`*`<sdmTMB_retro>`*`)`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot.sdmTMB_retro.md)
  : Plot retrospective indices from sdmTMB_retro
- [`plot(`*`<sdmTMB_selection>`*`)`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot.sdmTMB_selection.md)
  : Plot an sdmTMB selection table
- [`plot(`*`<sdmTMB_survey_comparison>`*`)`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/plot.sdmTMB_survey_comparison.md)
  : Plot survey comparison results

## Data

- [`sebastes`](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/sebastes.md)
  : Beaked redfish survey stations (example data)
